assumptions.statement: Site and key-area polygons are provisional rough geometry, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All area, ratio, alignment and distance values are reproducible draft indicators only.
assumptions.resolution: Replace with official GIS/CAD polygons and rerun every derivative.

assumptions.statement: Approved land use, FAR, height, density, setbacks and road redlines are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: No statutory control or development capacity conclusion is claimed.

assumptions.statement: CELL-001 uses a conceptual Existing Building + Public Forecourt carrier.
assumptions.impact: Existing building condition, ownership, fire access, accessibility and publicness remain unknown.
assumptions.resolution: Survey and legal/technical due diligence before site confirmation.

assumptions.statement: ZONE-01/02/03 are relative candidate zones derived from rough key-area geometry, registered Reality Map relationships and design synthesis.
assumptions.impact: ZONE-01 is first recommendation only; none is a confirmed site.
assumptions.resolution: Score after field observation, ownership/publicness, access and operator checks.

assumptions.statement: C1 Chengfu Road-Wudaokou is a design corridor, not an engineering centerline.
assumptions.impact: Route lengths and station handoff are not operational approvals.
assumptions.resolution: Conduct accessibility audit and coordinate the station-exterior handoff.

assumptions.impact: No real institution has agreed to participate, operate or fund the pilots.
assumptions.resolution: Use formal agreements before naming an institution as participant.

assumptions.statement: MVP telemetry and logs do not yet exist.
assumptions.impact: Performance KPIs remain unknown and no personal-data processing is authorized.
assumptions.resolution: Complete data protection impact assessment and minimum-data design.

assumptions.statement: MVP-03 / S03 Civic Information / Maintenance Loop is limited to low-risk, non-life-safety information and human-confirmed maintenance status.
assumptions.impact: It must not control fire, medical, rail, road traffic or other life-safety signals, and it cannot close maintenance tickets without human confirmation.
assumptions.resolution: Independent safety review and hard exclusion tests before pilot.

assumptions.statement: Surveyed building footprints, age, structure, use, vacancy and retain/renovate/demolish evidence are absent.
assumptions.impact: Submitted building polygons are conceptual carriers only.
assumptions.resolution: Acquire surveyed building and ownership data.

assumptions.statement: Utilities, drainage, flood, energy, fire and communications conditions are absent.
assumptions.impact: Municipal and distributed-infrastructure proposals remain strategies.
assumptions.resolution: Professional utility coordination before any works.

assumptions.statement: Heritage inventory and protection-control boundaries are absent.
assumptions.impact: Railway-memory narrative does not establish a legal heritage line.
assumptions.resolution: Use official heritage inventory and specialist review.

assumptions.statement: The five age-specific personas and optional evaluator role are design-testing constructs, not demographic claims.
assumptions.impact: They test accessibility, clarity, opt-out, maintenance and governance without asserting local population composition.
assumptions.resolution: Validate needs through future public engagement and accessibility review; never convert persona attributes into identity profiling.

assumptions.statement: The 2126 AI Living City horizon is subordinate to the 2026-2030 implementation core.
assumptions.impact: No century-scale implementation commitment is made.
assumptions.resolution: Review through periodic governance and retire obsolete concepts.
